    pid = playlist['playlist_id']
    original_title = playlist['title']
    song_ids = playlist['song_ids']
    # Count genres in order of song_ids
    genre_counts = {}
    for sid in song_ids:
        genre = song_genres[sid]
        genre_counts[genre] = genre_counts.get(genre, 0) + 1
    # Find max count, tie-break by first occurrence in song_ids order
    max_count = max(genre_counts.values())
    # Get genres with max count, pick first in song_ids order
    most_common = None
    for sid in song_ids:
        genre = song_genres[sid]
        if genre_counts[genre] == max_count:
            most_common = genre
            break
    new_title = f"{original_title} | {most_common}"
    playlist_updates.append((pid, new_title))
    print(f"Playlist {pid}: '{original_title}' -> '{new_title}' (genre: {most_common})")
